label: twin model vs recorded resting-state fMRI (held-out sessions): weak static match, FC-dynamics match
what: a digital twin model of one real person's brain structure and recorded activity; not a mind, not conscious, not the person

split.rule: sessions sorted by scan date (sub-01_sessions.tsv), alternately fit / held-out; multi-echo files of one acquisition merged

search.method: grid (36 points) then CMA-ES (4 generations x 12) on log-scaled parameters, then the best 4 candidates re-run with 3 new seeds; same procedure for each baseline; every evaluation 2 simulated runs of 518 volumes at TR 1.16 s
search.objective: r(simulated FC, recorded FC) - KS(simulated FCD, recorded FCD), fit half only

chronological_split.rule: first half of the sessions by date -> fit, second half -> held-out; parameters chosen from the grid only (the CMA-ES path used the interleaved fit half)

without_live_constraint.rule: best grid point with any G (the fitted model is limited to G <= 3.5 so that the sleep stages still work in the live server); same held-out protocol

notes: Digital twin model of one real person's brain structure and recorded activity; not a mind, not conscious, not the person. Scores compare simulated resting-state fMRI with recordings from sessions never used in the fit (split by session). fc_r: correlation over 22791 region pairs between simulated FC (each replicate 6 simulated 10-min runs) and the held-out mean FC; fcd_ks: Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance between FC-dynamics distributions (0 = identical, 1 = disjoint). The twin reaches r = 0.10, below what the log connectome weights alone give (r = 0.21) and far below the test-retest ceiling of the recordings themselves (r = 0.97). Same held-out data: shuffled connectome r = -0.00, old Stuart-Landau model r = 0.01. Typical published whole-brain fits reach r ~ 0.3-0.6, mostly with group-average connectomes. The fit is limited to coupling G <= 3.5 so that sleep stages still behave in the live model. Simulated mean FC (0.07) is lower than recorded (0.36). FCD is compared on the main-protocol runs (TR 1.16 s) only.
